description: This file defines the User class within the Opencart System Library for Cart, responsible for handling user-related functionalities such as login, logout, permission checks, and user data management.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents a user in the OpenCart system, managing user session, credentials, permissions, and profile information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the User object with dependencies from the registry and loads user data if a user session exists.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user with given username and password, initializes session data, and loads user permissions.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears the user session data and resets user properties.

methods.name: hasPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has a specific permission key and value.

methods.name: isLogged
methods.description: Determines if the user is currently logged in based on the user_id property.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the current user.

methods.name: getUserName
methods.description: Returns the username of the current user.

methods.name: getFirstName
methods.description: Returns the first name of the current user.

methods.name: getLastName
methods.description: Returns the last name of the current user.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Returns the email address of the current user.
